turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
That isn't what I asked. Who entered the zero, and what did they have in front of them when they did it?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then you'll understand why I'm here. Kind isn't evidence either way, Hale. What do you have?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?

You're leading me, and I've done this for twenty years. My son wrote that essay, and I'm not agreeing to anything that says otherwise. Show me what you have, or I'm going to the principal when we're done.
